findings: Robust and reproduced in both builds: three variants cost about the same as one traversal (p50 ratio 0.98 and 1.11), where the previous per-variant loop cost three traversals by construction.

Not resolvable on this host: whether one variant regressed. The two builds disagree with themselves - the initial batched build measured three variants faster than one, which is impossible - so machine noise exceeds the effect.
Every run here, including the pre-change build at 129.14 ms, is far above the 100 ms budget and the 92.85 ms committed baseline. The budget verdict needs a controlled host.
note: Measured on a developer workstation with Portavoz Dev and other applications running. PERF-001 requires a controlled host as the release authority, so these numbers are attribution evidence for D290 and are NOT a budget verdict. The committed 26 Jul baseline for the same 100k/512-dimension configuration is 92.85 ms p95; no run here approaches it, including the pre-change build.
